_comment: Copy into the project's .claude/settings.json, replacing REPO with the absolute path of this repository and WS with the application's workspace (python3 -m companion new WS --program PATH). The Stop hook runs the whole check, including any repair of the model by the LLM agent, so it gets a long timeout.

hooks.command: PYTHONPATH=REPO python3 -m companion --config WS hook user-prompt
PYTHONPATH=REPO python3 -m companion --config WS hook stop
